data.modules#Modules:
The modules of go-mswin listed here. Each links to its source and to its generated API reference.
Module Reference d3d11 pkg.go.dev screencapture pkg.go.dev win32 pkg.go.dev winrt pkg.go.dev d3d11 (v0.2.0) is a pure-Go binding of the part of Direct3D 11 that a compute kernel needs, with package dxgi alongside; COM is reached through syscall, with no cgo. It has run only on WARP, the software rasterizer of a Windows CI runner, and on no GPU.
Descriptions live on the repositories themselves rather than being copied here, so there is one place to correct when one changes.
